verdict.rationale: The Division documents its own way to track a submitted work order: choose "Work Request Status" on the public Contact Us page. It also offers alerts when filings are added to the public record and UCC status reports. However, the work-order route goes through a contact form rather than a self-service status page, and nothing shows instant results or that it covers applications and cases generally. Missing for 10: a self-service real-time status lookup page, coverage of applications and cases beyond work orders, and hands-on or independent confirmation of how status is returned.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: To track the status of a work order you sent us, use our Contact Us page, enter your contact information, choose Work Request Status from the drop down menu
You can sign up to receive free electronic (text/e-mail) messages to notify you when any filings for your business are added to the State's Public Records.
Access the UCC records system and obtain status reports, certified searches and copies of filed financing statements
